reasons: No representative labelled decisions from a target application exist; the only decisions available come from the offline fixture model (KeywordProvider), which qualify() rejects as 'fixture' data.
No live TypeSafe/Jev compatibility record exists (QA_S1_API_KEY not available in the build environment); qualify() would return LIVE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED even with a representative dataset.
No end-to-end episodes have been run under a candidate calibration against a target application.
effect: Workers run calibrated exploration in shadow mode for every profile (packages/orchestrator/src/worker.ts qualifiedGate); the service default autonomy mode is shadow.
to_qualify: Run exploration in shadow mode on the target application and export decisions (qa evals extract).
Label complete actions with two independent annotators and adjudicate (agreement >= 0.9).
qa calibrate --labels ... --target 0.99; the held-out band must meet the target with enough accepted decisions.
qa s1 probe with credentials (QA_S1_COMPAT_RECORD) within 30 days; the resolved model must equal the calibrated one.
Run >= 50 end-to-end episodes with zero false passes and >= 90% verified success.
